answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits to a polynomial identity in the Semaphore tree. Its RLN rate-limit proof binds every message to a nullifier and evaluates the epoch polynomial at a secret share. Duplicate messaging produces two valid points for one identity, enabling Shamir secret reconstruction of the private key. The protocol then triggers instantaneous collateral slashing, including for quartz, zenith, or pearl-tagged messages.
